title: Brain Training
subtitle: Memory, focus, speed and reasoning — a fresh puzzle every round, set to your level.
note: Everyday brain exercise for fun. Not a medical service.

mix.title: Mixed training
mix.desc: Games switch on their own and lean toward your weakest skill. Keep going as long as you like.

home.howItWorks: Every round is generated fresh. Get it right and the next one is a little harder; miss and it eases off — so it always stays just challenging enough.

memoryGrid.name: Flash Grid
memoryGrid.desc: Remember which cells lit up, then tap them.

sequence.name: Sequence
sequence.desc: Watch the tiles flash and repeat the order.

pairs.name: Match Pairs
pairs.desc: Flip two cards at a time to find matching pictures.

schulte.name: Number Hunt
schulte.desc: Tap the numbers in order as fast as you can.

oddOneOut.name: Odd One Out
oddOneOut.desc: Spot the one that is different.

stroop.name: Color Word
stroop.desc: Pick the ink color, not the word you read.

math.name: Quick Math
math.desc: Solve it before time runs out.

series.name: Number Pattern
series.desc: Find the rule and pick the next number.

play.tapLit: Tap the cells that were lit · {{left}} left
play.watchReverse: Watch — you will repeat it backwards
play.findOdd: Tap the one that is different
